posts.cooked: So, this is a sucky problem that I see no good way to fix, unfortunately. As dpt mentioned, the original several thousand copies of Enhanced Edition had inconsistent card sizes. posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
Yeah, it's only the errata cards which are too short - must be an EE Core Set thing, as the promo cards for Expatriette etc were the same size as the rest of their decks. I didn't actually think to compare a Rook City (or any other expansion) card to one from the EE to see if there was a size difference but I would presume there will be.

Incidentally, Silverleaf, the only cards whose played order matters are the ones which trigger at a specific time, which tends to be start or end of turn (matters most for Omni-10 I suppose). Anything else doesn't matter. So if they're playing pretty much anyone else it will be okay. I would have severe difficulty keeping track of the Adept if I couldn't lay out his cards in the order I wanted to (ie all instruments grouped together and then songs by type) ;).
